other_conditions: Applicant must hold the nationality of an ASEAN Member Country (Indian nationals are not eligible)
Must possess at least a Master’s degree in Natural Sciences or an equivalent degree in Technology/Engineering/Medicine/allied disciplines
Must be working, studying, or affiliated with a national R&D or academic institution in the home ASEAN country
Application must be endorsed by the Head of the applicant’s institution confirming leave for the fellowship period
Applicant must be fluent in English
Applicants who have received any fellowship from the Government of India in the last 3 years are ineligible
Proposed research in India must be linked to an ongoing project at the host Indian institute
A prior consent letter from the Indian host institution/scientist must be enclosed with the application
benefits_summary: Full financial assistance covering international airfare, a monthly stipend of INR 60,000, a one‑time research grant of INR 40,000, institutional overhead charges, and health‑insurance coverage.
documents_required: Endorsement letter from the head of the applicant’s institution
Consent letter from the Indian host institution/scientist
